svg.text: Source-defined INC path · Real DeepSeek E2E pending credentials · RAG / Utility chat branch is intentionally not shown
opt New Session only — existing sessions reuse their ID
loop Each normalized read-only tool: metrics / logs / traces [+ topology]
opt Validation fails: regenerate once; final failure returns insufficient evidence
opt A human later sends a valid decision for the pending action_id
INSERT session_id → thread_id; commit before exposure
MESSAGE REQUEST · HTTP validation and Redis quota precede traced ask
validation feedback → one new JSON generation
new JSON, then Python validates again
Saver checkpoints at graph steps / interrupt (not only at END)
HITL RESUME · Separate HTTP request, same Session / thread; no automatic approval
Write simulated / rejected audit; Saver checkpoints are separate writes
Guard failures keep existing 4xx / 503 rules; LLM/tool failures retain conservative fallback behavior.
Solid = request / internal call · Dashed = return / lifeline · opt / alt / loop are source-defined · Synthetic evidence; simulated actions only
